comparison.objective: Receive a terminal block from a person and latch it onto a DIN rail.
comparison.physical_skill: Force-limited handover followed by aligned snap mounting without moving the loose rail.
comparison.success_condition: Clean handover and released block latched on both rail lips; human-contact, drop, and rail-motion limits respected.
comparison.reason: Although both involve a rail and alignment, this record tests human handover plus perpendicular snap-latching. The candidate tests longitudinal support continuity between a rail and jig and preservation of free bearing balls.
